candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a small positive constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents the low positive valid-reference partition for constant speed tracking.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate positive constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a representative interior positive reference without introducing a numerical tracking threshold.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking near the upper nominal positive reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained reference provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a positive reference close to, but strictly inside, the nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a small negative constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents the low negative valid-reference partition for constant speed tracking.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate negative constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a representative interior negative reference.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking near the lower nominal negative reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest with no persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained reference provided persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a negative reference close to, but strictly inside, the nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify tracking behavior for a zero constant speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from a nonzero initial motor speed and allow the zero reference to remain constant.
candidates.expected_behavior: The closed-loop motor speed converges stably to the maintained zero reference.
candidates.rationale: Covers the zero-reference partition without applying a sign expectation from REQ-DIR-001.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction for a low positive speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a positive reference close to zero while remaining non-zero and valid.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction for a representative positive speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Covers an interior positive-reference direction case.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction near the upper nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Checks positive direction at a high valid reference magnitude.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction for a low negative speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a negative reference close to zero while remaining non-zero and valid.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction for a representative negative speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Covers an interior negative-reference direction case.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction near the lower nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start the MIL simulation from rest and maintain the reference until steady state.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the non-zero SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Checks negative direction at a high valid reference magnitude.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from a moderate positive speed to a moderate negative speed.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation at the first reference value before applying the second value.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the positive-to-negative reversal state transition with symmetric magnitudes.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from a moderate negative speed to a moderate positive speed.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation at the first reference value before applying the second value.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the required negative-to-positive reversal direction.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-to-negative reversal across a large valid reference change.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation at the first reference value before applying the second value.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises reversal with unequal magnitudes and a high-magnitude negative final reference.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative-to-positive reversal across a large valid reference change.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady operation at the first reference value before applying the second value.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Complements the large positive-to-negative reversal with the opposite direction.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal through a zero reference from positive to negative operation.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady positive operation, apply zero as an intermediate reference, then establish the negative final reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive operation through the zero-reference state to negative operation and converges stably to the final direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises an intermediate zero-reference state during reversal.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal through a zero reference from negative to positive operation.
candidates.precondition: Establish steady negative operation, apply zero as an intermediate reference, then establish the positive final reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from negative operation through the zero-reference state to positive operation and converges stably to the final direction.
candidates.rationale: Complements the opposite-direction zero-crossing reversal.

candidates.test_objective: Verify repeated bidirectional reversals remain convergent at each final reference.
candidates.precondition: Allow each successive piecewise-constant reference to establish operation before applying the next reversal.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed completes the positive-to-negative reversal and then the negative-to-positive reversal, converging stably to the final positive direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises both required reversal directions in one executable scenario.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a zero reference.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval with the reference held constant at zero.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd is no greater than +12 V and the minimum Vcmd is no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Covers the zero-reference input partition for the voltage-limit requirement.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a positive command.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from rest with the positive reference held constant.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd is no greater than +12 V and the minimum Vcmd is no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limiting during positive-direction operation.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a negative command.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from rest with the negative reference held constant.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd is no greater than +12 V and the minimum Vcmd is no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limiting during negative-direction operation.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within limits during a high-magnitude positive-to-negative reversal.
candidates.precondition: Establish operation at the first reference, apply the reversal, and evaluate Vcmd over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd is no greater than +12 V and the minimum Vcmd is no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Exercises both voltage-limit polarities during a high-magnitude direction reversal.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within limits during a high-magnitude negative-to-positive reversal.
candidates.precondition: Establish operation at the first reference, apply the reversal, and evaluate Vcmd over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd is no greater than +12 V and the minimum Vcmd is no less than -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Complements the opposite high-magnitude reversal while observing the complete voltage envelope.
